ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in Figure 1, $E$ is a point on the side $BC$ of the equilateral triangle $\triangle ABC$ (not coinciding with point $B$ or $C$). Connect $AE$ and construct an equilateral triangle $\triangle AEF$ to the right using $AE$ as a side, and connect $CF$. It is known that the function relationship between the area ($S$) of $\triangle ECF$ and the length ($x$) of $BE$ is shown in Figure 2 ($P$ is the vertex of the parabola). When the area of $\triangle ECF$ is maximized, what is the degree measure of $\angle FEC$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Let the side length of the equilateral $\triangle ABC$ be $a$. Draw $FD\perp BC$ at $D$, \\
$\because$ $\triangle ABC$ is equilateral, $\triangle AEF$ is equilateral, \\
$\therefore AB=AC$, $AE=AF$, $\angle BAC=\angle ABC=\angle ACB=\angle EAF=\angle AEF=60^\circ$, \\
$\therefore \angle BAE=\angle CAF$, \\
$\therefore \triangle ABE\cong \triangle ACF$ (SAS), \\
$\therefore CF=BE=x$, $\angle ACF=\angle ABE=60^\circ$, $\angle FCD=180^\circ-\angle ACB-\angle ACF=60^\circ$, \\
$FD=CF\cdot\sin60^\circ=\frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}x$, \\
$S_{\triangle ECF}=\frac{1}{2}CE\times FD = -\frac{\sqrt{3}}{4}x^2+\frac{\sqrt{3}}{4}ax$ \\
$\therefore$ When $S_{\triangle ECF}$ is maximized, $x= \frac{1}{2}a$, i.e., E is the midpoint of BC, the maximum value of $S_{\triangle ECF}$ is $\frac{\sqrt{3}}{16}a^2$ \\
$\because$ E is the midpoint of BC \\
$\therefore AE\perp BC$, $\angle AEB=90^\circ$ \\
$\therefore \angle FEC=180^\circ-\angle AEB-\angle AEF=30^\circ$ \\
Hence, the measure of $\angle FEC$ is $\boxed{30^\circ}$.
